test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

He tends to __put off doing his work__ until the last minute, leaving important tasks unfinished and causing himself unnecessary stress.
solution: The correct answer is: **Procrastinate**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Procrastinate **means to delay or postpone action, which is the exact behaviour described in the sentence. (कार्रवाई में देरी करना या स्थगित करना) • **Example**: *Despite having a deadline, he tends to procrastinate on his assignments.* • The sentence also uses the phrase "**put off**," which is a synonym for procrastinate. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Decline **means to decrease or refuse. (कम करना या मना करना) • **Adjourn **means to postpone or end a meeting. (किसी बैठक को स्थगित या समाप्त करना) • **Dwindle **means to become smaller or weaker. (छोटा या कमजोर हो जाना) 47:T9a7, The correct answer is: **Contender**.
